profile.name: Chen-Jui Yu
profile.tagline: I build retrieval systems that read tables, pick tools, and speak low-resource languages.
bio: Ph.D. student in Computer Science at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University.
My research is on table retrieval & table QA, tool retrieval for LLM agents,
and NLP for Taiwan's indigenous languages. I also love backend & infra work.
profile.status: Currently: table & tool retrieval for LLMs

research.title: Table Retrieval & QA
research.text: Header-aware representations and LLM-made supervision for finding the right table.

research.title: Tool Retrieval
research.text: Training-free ways for LLM agents to pick the right tool from thousands.

research.title: Low-Resource NLP
research.text: Translation and dialogue for Taiwan's indigenous languages with LLMs.

research.title: Systems & Infra
research.text: Backend, self-hosted LLM serving, and the plumbing that makes research ship.
